Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: PSIONIC PRESENCE: PASSIVE All Weapons of Friendly Units targeting an Enemy Unit Within 4" of this
Unit's Shade token gain PRECISION (1) .

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: PSIONIC TRANSFER: ACTIVE 1 PE Set a Shade token Wholly Within 12" of any
model in this Unit. At the End of the Round , the controlling player may set all models of this Unit in Coherency ,
treating the Shade token as the Leading Model . The Shade token has DISPLACEMENT .

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: COMMANDER: PASSIVE Treat this Unit's Supply characteristic as increased by 1 for Controlling and
Contesting Mission Markers , completing objectives, and resolving Disengage checks.

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: PHASE PRISM: PASSIVE When Artanis is nominated to deploy from Reserves , it
may resolve the PLACE (0) effect from another Friendly Unit. That Friendly Unit is removed from the battlefield and
returned to Reserves . Artanis ' Activation ends.

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: LIGHTNING DASH:
REACTION 1 PE After this Unit resolves a successful
Charge action, it may declare a second Charge action
against a different Enemy Unit, ignoring the restriction
on Charging while Engaged . The Devastating Charge
ability does not trigger a second time.
HIERARCH'S STAND: REACTION 1 PE When another
Friendly Unit Within 8" is declared as the target of a
Ranged Attack and this Unit is a valid target, redirect the
attack to this Unit. This Unit is eligible to make an Evade
Roll against the redirected attack. This Special Ability
remains active until the End of the current Activation .
DEVASTATING CHARGE: PASSIVE Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge , resolve the IMPACT
(6) 4+ effect.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: OUR MINDS AS ONE: PASSIVE While this Unit's Current Supply Value is 2 , it gains the following effects:
The first Special Ability resolved by this Unit each Round has its PE cost reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0 ). Apply a +1
Modifier to the dice rolled for its Psionic Storm Special Ability .

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: FEEDBACK: ACTIVE 1 PE Target one Enemy Mechanical or Psionic Unit Within 8" .
Until the End of the Round , after that Unit resolves an Active or Reaction Special Ability ( excluding abilities
granted by a Tactical Card or Faction Card ), it suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (3) .

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: IMPROVED BARRIER: REACTION 0 PE Use when this Unit is selected as the target of an attack. If this Unit
has the Shielded Status , the Damage characteristic of the attacking weapon is treated as a maximum of 1 for this attack.

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: INDOMITABLE: PASSIVE While Engaged , this Unit
may target and be targeted by Unengaged Enemy
Units. In both cases, the defending Unit gains an Evade
Roll against those attacks.
DEVASTATING CHARGE: PASSIVE Immediately after
this Unit completes a successful Charge , resolve the
IMPACT (4) 3+ effect.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: PATH OF SHADOWS: ACTIVE 1 PE This
Unit gains HIDDEN Status until it performs another action.
NERAZIM FARSIGHT: PASSIVE While Enemy Units
are Within 6" of this Unit's Shade token, they lose
HIDDEN Status .

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: PSIONIC TRANSFER: ACTIVE 1 PE Set a Shade token Wholly Within 12" of any
model in this Unit. At the End of the Round , the controlling player may set all models of this Unit in Coherency ,
treating the Shade token as the Leading Model . The Shade token has DISPLACEMENT .

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: SHIELD OVERCHARGE: PASSIVE This Unit gains TOUGH (2) on the first Armour Roll each Round.

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: LEG ENHANCEMENTS: ACTIVE 1 PE This Unit performs a 2" Move action. This does
not count towards its action limit.

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: CHARGE: ACTIVE 1 PE
When determining Charge Distance for this Unit, roll
2D6 instead of D6 and use the higher result to add to
the Unit's Speed characteristic.
DEVASTATING CHARGE: PASSIVE Immediately after
this Unit completes a successful Charge , resolve the
IMPACT (3) 4+ effect.

Name: Combat Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Combat Phase)
Effect: TITAN KILLERS: PASSIVE When this Unit makes a Close
Combat Attack , and the target is Size 3 or larger, the
weapon's Damage characteristic is treated as 2 .
PRECOGNITION: PASSIVE This Unit is eligible to make
an Evade roll against all attacks targeting it.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: KHALAI INGENUITY: PASSIVE Once per
Round , when a Friendly Unit Within 4" of this Pylon uses
a Special Ability that costs Psionic Energy , that ability's
PE cost is reduced by 1 .
STRUCTURE: PASSIVE This Unit cannot be Activated
in any Phase and cannot perform actions. Additionally,
its Current Supply Value is treated as 0 , and it can
never Control or Contest Mission Markers , ignoring the
standard Zero Supply Exception . This Unit cannot be
a target of an ability, unless stated otherwise.

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: WARP CONDUIT: PASSIVE Once per Round , the controlling player may deploy
a Ground Unit from Reserves using this Pylon base as the Entry Edge . This Unit's Activation ends.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: RESTORATION: REACTION 1 PE Use when a Friendly Unit Within 4" receives a DEBUFF . Remove
all DEBUFFS from it.

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: GUARDIAN SHIELD:
ACTIVE 1 PE All Ranged Attacks targeting a Friendly
Unit Within 4" ( Line of Sight is not required) are made
with 1 fewer die in the Attack Pool .
FORCE FIELD: ACTIVE 1 PE Set a Force Field token
Within 8" in an unoccupied space. Units of Size 2 or
lower cannot move across Force Fields . Models of Size
3 or more can move over it, and it's then removed.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: SQUADRON: PASSIVE This Unit's Horizontal Coherency is 4" .

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: BLINK: ACTIVE 1 PE Resolve the PLACE (6) effect. Models set by this effect cannot
be set up Within the Engagement Range of any Enemy Unit.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: COMMANDER: PASSIVE Treat this Unit's Supply characteristic as increased by 1 for Controlling and
Contesting Mission Markers , completing objectives, and resolving Disengage checks.

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: FORCE WALL:
ACTIVE 1 PE Set two Force Wall tokens Wholly Within
8" in an unoccupied space. Units of Size 2 or lower cannot
move across the Force Wall . Models of Size 3 or more can
move over it, and it's then removed.
KHALA'S GIFT: ACTIVE 0 PE Target another Friendly
Biological Unit Within 12" . Until the End of the
Round , that Unit resolves its first Special Ability with
the cost reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0 ).
EXECUTOR'S WILL: ACTIVE 1 PE Target two Enemy
Units on the battlefield ( Line of Sight is not required)
and place a Faction Indicator next to each of them.
During the next Assault Phase , if either of these Units
ends its Activation while its Faction Indicator remains
on the battlefield, you may Activate two Friendly
Units consecutively. Remove both Faction Indicators
after any Enemy Unit completes its Activation in the
following Assault Phase .

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: PSI LIGHTNING : ACTIVE 0 PE Each Unit Within 2" of one or more Friendly Force Wall tokens suffers 1 Damage .
TELEKINETIC PUSH: ACTIVE 1 PE Set each Friendly Force Wall token Wholly Within 6" of its current position.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: BOUND BY THE KHALA: REACTION 0 PE Use when the Current Supply Value of another Friendly Unit
Within 8" of this Unit is reduced. Return one Non-Unique Exhausted Tactical Card to the Ready state.

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: PSIONIC GALE: ACTIVE 2 PE Set a Psionic Storm token Within 10" and Line of
Sight of this Unit. This token is not removed if this Unit is Destroyed . At the End of each Phase , set a Psionic
Storm Blast Template on the centre of this token. For each Unit that has at least one model whose base is partially
covered by the template, roll 3 dice, plus 1 additional die for each model in that Unit whose base is partially
covered. For each result of 4+ , that Unit suffers an effect depending on the current Phase :
‣ Movement Phase: NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (1) .
‣ Assault Phase : 1 Damage .
If multiple effects trigger at the End of the Assault Phase , resolve them in the order specified in Part 8.9.4.
FEEDBACK: ACTIVE 1 PE Target one Enemy Mechanical or Psionic Unit Within 8" . Until the End of the Round , after
that Unit resolves an Active or Reaction Special Ability ( excluding abilities granted by a Tactical Card or Faction Card ),
it suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (3) .
WARP-IN: ACTIVE 1 PE Resolve the PLACE (6) effect.

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: CHARGE: ACTIVE 1 PE When
determining Charge Distance for this Unit, roll 2D6
instead of D6 and use the higher result to add to the
Unit's Speed characteristic.
DEVASTATING CHARGE: PASSIVE Immediately after
this Unit completes a successful Charge , resolve the
IMPACT (3) 4+ effect.

Name: Any Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Any Phase)
Effect: ONE WITH THE SHADOWS: PASSIVE
After this Unit fully resolves an Action , it gains the
HIDDEN Status .
PROPHETIC VISION: REACTION 1 PE REPEATABLE . Use
when this Unit is selected as the target of an attack. This Unit's
Evade characteristic is treated as 4+ against this attack and
cannot be modified.

Name: Movement Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Movement Phase)
Effect: SENTENCED TO DEATH:
ACTIVE 1 PE Target Enemy Unit on the battlefield.
Whenever Zeratul makes a Close Combat Attack targeting
the selected Unit, its weapon gains CRITICAL HIT (2) .
VOID PRISON: ACTIVE 1 PE Set a Faction Indicator
on the battlefield Within 8" of this Unit. While Enemy
Units are Within 2" of this Faction Indicator they suffer
DEBUFF Speed (2) .

Name: Assault Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Assault Phase)
Effect: VOID BLINK: ACTIVE 1 PE
If Unengaged , resolve the PLACE (6) effect.
DEVASTATING CHARGE: PASSIVE Immediately after
this Unit completes a successful Charge , resolve the
IMPACT (4) 4+ effect.

Name: Combat Phase abilities
Description:
Rules (Combat Phase)
Effect: SHADOW STRIKE: ACTIVE 1 PE All Enemy Units Engaged with this Unit suffer HITS 4 (1) .
